title: Frequently asked questions
subtitle: Honest and plain — just like in a conversation

items.question: Who do you work with?
items.answer: With owners of small companies — trade, services, manufacturing — that run their own system (e.g. an ERP like Comarch), a warehouse, sales on marketplaces, and all their IT on a single computer under the desk. If you want it to simply work and someone to take responsibility for it — that's me.

items.question: How much does it cost?
items.answer: Managed IT care starts at 800 PLN per month. Projects and rollouts are priced by outcome — after a short conversation you know up front what you get and for how much, and you pay in instalments. I never start work without a clear quote, so you're never surprised by an invoice.

items.question: I'm not technical — is that a problem?
items.answer: Quite the opposite, that's what I'm here for. I talk to you plainly, without jargon — I explain what's happening and why something is (or isn't) worth doing. You make the business decisions, I take responsibility for the work.

items.question: Who owns the data and hardware?
items.answer: You do. I work as a consultant — the server, database and hardware are and remain your property. I look after them, keep the backups in check and know how everything works, but at any moment you are the owner of your own infrastructure.

items.question: How fast do you respond?
items.answer: Under managed care I guarantee I'll pick up the matter within 24 hours. I usually reply to a first message the same day.

items.question: Do you work remotely or on-site?
items.answer: Mostly remotely — it's faster and cheaper. But when the server under the desk needs a physical look, or a training has to happen on-site, I come over. I work across Poland.

items.question: What if my problem isn't your thing?
items.answer: I'll say so straight. If I'm not the right person, I'll admit it honestly and — if I can — point you to someone who can help. I'd rather lose the job than your time and trust.

items.question: How do we start?
items.answer: Write or call and describe the problem in plain words. I'll get back to you within 24 hours and tell you honestly whether I can help, what it costs, and if it's not me — who.
